chunks: Hishām ibn Sālim narrated from Sulaymān ibn Khālid, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: “Whoever initiates aggression and is then retaliated against, there is no retribution for him.”

key_terms.فَاعْتُدِيَ عَلَيْهِ: retaliatory force was directed against him
key_terms.قَوَدَ: legal retribution (qisas) in injury or homicide cases

ai.seo_question: Does someone who initiates an assault have a right to qisas if force is used against him in return?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning retaliation in cases of injury or assault. If a person is the one who first commits aggression and is then met with counter-aggression, he is not entitled to demand qisas for what results from that response.
